editorial.blurb: Benihana's John Hancock location delivers theatrical hibachi dining where skilled chefs perform tableside magic with pristine ingredients and impeccable technique.
editorial.insiderTip: Request your preferred chef by name when booking—reviewers rave about specific performers like Ardis, Aidan, and Jayson whose energy and precision elevate the entire experience.

topDishes.note: Delicious and expertly prepared with evident care
